# `smelt.style`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

Compose shared style values without resolving their theme references, or resolve a current style snapshot.

## `smelt.style.merge`

```lua
fun(base: smelt.Style | string, patch: smelt.Style | string): table
```

Types: [`smelt.Style`](types.md#smeltstyle)

Return a fresh style table with patch fields over base fields. Strings become hl_group references; colors and explicit false stay unchanged. Neither input is modified. A patch hl_group replaces the base group reference, while other explicit base fields remain.

## `smelt.style.resolve`

```lua
fun(style: smelt.Style | string): table
```

Types: [`smelt.Style`](types.md#smeltstyle)

Validate a shared style and resolve its theme references. The result is a snapshot; keep references in long-lived views to follow theme changes.
